classes.name: Oral corticosteroids
classes.description: Systemic oral corticosteroids: prednisone (tablets, solution; Rayos delayed-release appears discontinued), methylprednisolone (Medrol, dose pack), prednisolone (solution, Orapred ODT, Millipred), dexamethasone (tablets, solution, Dexamethasone Intensol, TaperDex/Dxevo/HiDex packs; Hemady 20 mg is labeled for multiple myeloma only, an alternative, never the pick), hydrocortisone (Cortef; Alkindi Sprinkle and Khindivi oral solution for children). Deflazacort (Emflaza) and vamorolone (Agamree) for Duchenne are specialty alternatives only, never the pick. Not budesonide (Entocort, Uceris, Tarpeyo) or inhaled/topical steroids.
classes.plainDescription: Short courses of steroid pills that calm inflammation fast, for flares of asthma, COPD, arthritis, allergies and more.
classes.indication: Inflammatory flares, asthma/COPD exacerbations, autoimmune disease, adrenal insufficiency

records.verificationNote: Read PDL p.26-27 (GLUCOCORTICOIDS, ORAL) by x-position. Prednisone tablet is Preferred with no code. Generic methylprednisolone, dexamethasone, hydrocortisone and prednisolone solution are Preferred. Brand Medrol, Cortef, Hemady, Emflaza and Agamree are Non-Preferred (PA). Hemady is an alternative in the class description but is Non-Preferred on the PDL, so it is recorded as PA. Budesonide products (Eohilia, Tarpeyo, Entocort-type) are not systemic steroids for this class and are not recorded. Fludrocortisone is not in the class description and is not recorded. Sig is a label-based judgment; the PDL prints none.

records.verificationNote: Read Highmark c22 (glucocorticoids) from the raw HTML. Prednisone 10 mg tablet is Tier 1 (Low-Cost Generic Rx icon). Generic methylprednisolone, dexamethasone, hydrocortisone, prednisolone solution and prednisone dose packs are Tier 1. Cortef, Medrol strengths other than 2 mg, Millipred and Orapred are Tier 3. Hemady, Rayos, prednisone DR, deflazacort-type products (Emflaza, Jaythari, Kymbee, Pyquvi), Agamree, Alkindi and Khindivi carry PA icons and Tier 3 status. Eohilia and Tarpeyo (budesonide) excluded per the class description. Dexamethasone injection excluded (not oral). The page prints no sig.
